# 🎮 Awesome Adventure Game

## How to Play
- **Move**: Use the arrow keys (or WASD) to navigate the character.
- **Jump**: Press the Spacebar to leap over obstacles.
- **Collect**: Gather coins and power‑ups to boost your score.
- **Win**: Reach the finish line before time runs out!

## Controls
| Action | Key |
|--------|-----|
| Move Left | ← or A |
| Move Right | → or D |
| Jump | Space |
| Pause | P |
